title: Alphabet-Dependent Bounds for Pure Quantum $(r,ρ)$-Locally Recoverable Codes
summary: A quantum $(r,ρ)$-locally recoverable code ($(r,ρ)$-qLRC) is a quantum code in which every qudit can be recovered from at most $r+ρ-1$ other qudits, even after $ρ-1$ additional erasures inside the recovery set. The bounds currently known for this class, namely the Singleton-like and the GG Singleton-like bounds, are alphabet independent and are therefore loose for small-to-moderate qudit dimensions. In this letter, we derive three alphabet-dependent upper bounds for pure $(r,ρ)$-qLRCs obtained through the Hermitian CSS construction: a Griesmer-like, a Plotkin-like, and a sphere-packing-like…
